557:t_043:8.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Even if, to my eyes, he started at the very bottom of the thug business.」

557:t_043:9.en:
$$ベック$$
「Now I'm pissed! I was thinking about what to do with myself a moment ago, but that can wait!」

557:t_043:10.en:
$$ベック$$
「First I'll crush you! I'll think about the future afterward!」

557:t_043:11.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Very well. Then, for the sake of your rehabilitation, I shall deliberately indulge your methods.」

557:t_043:12.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Come on! I'll face you with $$ビッグオー$$'s full power!」

557:t_043:13.en:
$$ベック$$
「Damn it! You're enjoying this way too much, as always!」

557:t_044:0.en:
$$ベック$$
「Shit! I've had enough of this!」

557:t_044:2.en:
$$Ｔボーン$$
「You've had enough... What are you going to do!?」

557:t_044:3.en:
$$ベック$$
「I'll figure that out later! For now, we're making tracks!」

557:t_044:5.en:
$$ベック$$
「Take care, $$ロジャー$$! If fate brings us together, we'll meet again!」

557:t_044:6.en:
$$ベック$$
「And I'll beat you to a pulp then!」

557:t_045:0.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「...At least this should sever his ties with $$アマルガム$$.」

557:t_045:1.en:
$$ドロシー#bigo$$
「You care about him more than I'd expect.」

557:t_045:2.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「A negotiator and a thug... We may be like oil and water, but we're both from $$パラダイムシティ$$.」

557:t_045:3.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I don't intend to become his friend, but it's true that he concerns me.」

557:t_045:4.en:
$$ドロシー#bigo$$
「Do as you please. I'm used to your contrariness.」

557:t_045:6.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Though I don't want to see him badly enough to chase after him.」

557:t_046:2.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Of course! I've got a grudge against it!」

557:t_047:2.en:
$$カヲル$$
(The Tenth Angel... An opponent tied to bitter memories for $$シンジ$$.)

557:t_048:0.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Even if we've fought it before, defeating an Angel in one blow...」

557:t_048:1.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「We grow every day, too. This is humanity's strength.」

557:t_048:2.en:
$$テッサ$$
「We cannot allow anything that would halt that progress.」

557:t_048:3.en:
$$テッサ$$
(Are you watching, $$レナード$$? We cannot lose to you and your fixation on the past.)

557:t_100:0.en:
$$宗介$$
(Hold on, $$千鳥$$... This time, I'll rescue you.)

557:t_100:1.en:
$$宗介$$
(To hell with $$レナード$$, $$ソフィア$$, and the Major...! I'll use any means to bring you back!)

557:t_101:0.en:
$$ベック$$
「What a grand stage! I'll settle everything here, $$ロジャー・スミス$$!」

557:t_101:1.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「My apologies, $$ベック$$. Unlike an idle fellow such as you, my schedule afterward is quite full.」

557:t_101:2.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Therefore, I'll finish dealing with you quickly!」

557:t_101:3.en:
$$ベック$$
「Bastard! You keep pissing me off right to the end!」

557:t_101:4.en:
$$ベック$$
「$$ロジャー・スミス$$! You're still the most infuriating bastard in the world!」

557:t_101:5.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Your saying that doesn't trouble me in the slightest.」

557:t_102:1.en:
$$シンジ$$
(There's no $$ＮＥＲＶ$$ here, and Father isn't here... But that Angel who made $$アスカ$$ and $$綾波$$ suffer... with my own hands...!)

557:t_103:0.en:
$$シンジ$$
(The spear... The power to redo the world...)

557:t_103:1.en:
$$シンジ$$
(But I won't think about that now... What I can do in this world... I'll fight for that.)

557:t_104:0.en:
$$レナード$$
「I know. I know your battles have been days of suffering and sorrow.」

557:t_104:2.en:
$$レナード$$
「If you're willing, I'll invite you to a world where your friends who were blown up are alive.」

557:t_104:4.en:
$$勝平$$
「Dad said... Because we can't go back to the past, we live the present to the fullest and try to make the future better!」

557:t_104:5.en:
$$勝平$$
「I won't listen to someone like you who runs from his pain and sorrow and wants a good life only for himself!」

557:t_105:0.en:
$$万丈$$
「Changing the past... I can't tell whether you're positive or negative...」

557:t_105:1.en:
$$レナード$$
「Are you trying to provoke me?」

557:t_105:2.en:
$$万丈$$
「I have no desire to converse with you. Because I both despise and pity you.」

557:t_105:4.en:
$$万丈$$
「I won't let someone who sees no hope in the future have his way with this world!」

557:t_105:5.en:
$$万丈$$
「The sun will rise again! I won't listen to you when you can't believe that!」

557:t_106:0.en:
$$レナード$$
「If you wish, I could prepare a world where your company is a major corporation.」

557:t_106:1.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Hey, you! You're mocking $$竹尾ゼネラルカンパニー$$ for always barely staying out of the red!」

557:t_106:2.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Too bad! I... don't care about that at all!」

557:t_106:3.en:
$$レナード$$
「Ignoring profits to help people... Employees with a manager like you are unfortunate.」

557:t_106:4.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Don't decide that for us! We're a small company now, but we're going to keep growing!」

557:t_106:5.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「That's why I'll protect this world's future! That's my duty as President!!」

557:t_107:0.en:
$$レナード$$
「A life of fighting criminals, with neither father nor mother... Doesn't it feel empty?」

557:t_107:2.en:
$$レナード$$
「I suppose it does... But I can save you from your sorrow.」

557:t_107:4.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Because what makes me sad is that people suffer because of selfish people like you!」

557:t_107:6.en:
$$正太郎$$
「$$鉄人$$'s power exists for peace! I'll use it to fight people like you!」

557:t_108:0.en:
$$甲児$$
「We've cornered you, villain! We'll end your ambition here!」

557:t_108:1.en:
$$レナード$$
「You don't seem to understand what I'm thinking.」

557:t_108:2.en:
$$甲児$$
「I don't give a damn about your fixing the world!」

557:t_108:3.en:
$$甲児$$
「What I can't forgive is that you attacked my school and made my friend and his girlfriend suffer!!」

557:t_109:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Come on, coward. I'll beat that rotten spirit out of you.」

557:t_109:1.en:
$$レナード$$
「Are you mocking what I do as spineless?」

557:t_109:2.en:
$$竜馬$$
「If you're angry, come at me. I'll crush your ambition along with that machine you're so proud of.」

557:t_109:3.en:
$$竜馬$$
「As a staff member of $$陣代高校$$, I'll make you pay right here!」

557:t_110:0.en:
$$レナード$$
「You've lost your family... your beloved brother. I would think you could understand me.」

557:t_110:1.en:
$$タケル$$
「$$マーグ$$'s death is in the past, too. He taught me that being trapped in the past keeps us from moving toward the future.」

557:t_110:2.en:
$$タケル$$
「I won't hand a world moving toward the future to you when you're trying to return to the past!」

557:t_111:0.en:
$$シモン$$
「It's not like I don't understand how you feel...! But what good will doing that accomplish!?」

557:t_111:1.en:
$$レナード$$
「It accomplishes something. The world can take the right path this way.」
